description: Pachchilaipalli Pradeshiya Sabha - Acceptance of Standard by - Laws
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the acceptance and implementation of standard by-laws by a local authority (Pachchilaippalli Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities (Standard By-laws) Act, No. 06 of 1952. The content focuses on regulatory frameworks and legal instruments rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or any other specialized category. It deals specifically with the establishment of legal regulations for local governance, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette.
